title: Share pure request translation between initial seed matching and mounted dispatch

conversation_composer_owner.rs:92-95 wraps already tagged ComposerHostResponse values in a second Page/ObjectPage enum; construction and selected_preparation unwrap or reconstruct that tag. proposal: Expose small private pure conversion functions at the existing main_window adapter boundary and use them from seed compatibility and normal dispatch. title: Retain distinct mount, widget, service and native cleanup custody boundaries
evidence: All cohort source and tests reviewed together. Mount visibility, widget realization, service-held durable session/close work and retiring native sources terminate at different moments. The service intentionally retains cleanup custody after widget/route loss; tests exercise blocked validation, two retained cleanup sources and capacity rearm.

Saved opening is clean based on the authenticated saved selector even with nonzero candidate generation. Resident close retains a read-only selectable/copyable/scrollable widget until final disposal, and close failure must not clear an independent unavailable state. Clipboard paging retains bounded range state and one marker tail across physical pages.

Native prompt state has many optional fields, but cancellation ordering, restoration seed, current/estimated predecessor and service-owned cleanup are not interchangeable. A wholesale enum/RAII replacement did not establish a conservative net reduction without moving these responsibilities.
proposal: Retain these domain boundaries and the existing RangeClipboardCoordinator integration. Local aggregate-field or terminal-tail cleanup can be reconsidered during implementation but has no counted savings here. No substantial dependency replacement was identified in this cohort: the remaining cost is exact identity, bounded editor ownership and durable cleanup integration; replacing it with a generic lifecycle/task framework would retain those adapters. This is a boundary assessment, not a claim of an exhaustive crates.io survey. Exclude already-mandated lifecycle/registry removal and keep PRE-015 a proposal; unmounted required architecture is not dead code.
required_contract_changes: None. Effective authority remains composer feature/GUI and beryl-app design, plus backend runtime recovery GUI/native prompt contracts. Preserve exact root/history submission, stale generation fencing, checked range/object/geometry budgets, mark/image metadata authentication, close/flush attempt identity and cleanup release ordering.
verification: Observational audit only; no build, tests or GUI execution performed.

Implementation of any later cleanup must retain exact_root_submission, saved_opening, resident_close_flush, composer_lifecycle, mounted/pending activation, scale and native recovery scenario evidence. No tests or dependencies were changed during this audit.
